summary: Implemented full authentication flow: created AuthContext with login/logout/password-reset state management, useAuth hook, login form with phone+password, two-step password reset form (request code via SMS then enter code+new password), and AuthLayout wrapper that gates the main app behind authentication. Token stored in localStorage on login, cleared on logout, no automatic session restoration. All forms styled with existing Tailwind design system including loading spinners, inline validation errors, and gradient buttons. Subscribe modal remains accessible without auth for public subscribers.
